# CANDIDATE: NAMED_LEVEL_RSI_DIVERGENCE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

At the prior day’s high (named level) a bearish RSI divergence on the 5‑minute chart predicts an intraday reversal short. This edge exists because the named level acts as resistance and the bearish RSI divergence indicates weakening momentum despite the price making a new high, suggesting a higher probability of a short-term reversal.

## Mechanism

Entry: When the SPY price touches the prior day's high (within 0.05%) on a 5-minute bar, and the 5-minute RSI(14) forms a lower high while the price forms a higher high (bearish divergence), and the volume of that bar is above the 20-bar average volume, enter a short position at the close of the bar.  
Exit: Chart stop at prior day high + 0.1% (invalidates the level), initial target at 1R (distance from entry to stop), with a runner trailed 12% off the highest water mark (for a short, interpreted as trailing the stop upward from the lowest price reached since entry by 12% of the favorable excursion). Regime hint: Effective when VIX > 18 (higher volatility) and time is between 10:00‑11:30 EST; avoid low‑VIX choppy periods.
